菊儿胡同3号院，今日热闹极了，被大家围了里三层外三层，跟街头看西洋景似的，七嘴八舌地问着前线的情况。
“济民，你打死了几个越南鬼子？”
“哎呦，大英雄欸，一定打死了不少，我看报纸上啊，说是一等功！”
“可不是嘛，咱这院里，上一次上战场的还是瓜尔佳氏，荣禄！”
“说不定啊，要出一个将军喽！”
“大喜的日子，你提那荣禄干嘛，这不是扫兴嘛！”
“哎呦，真是！”
围进来的荣禄后人听到后，顿时黑着脸走了出去。
刘济民跟大家讲了几句，战场并不像是嘴上说的那样轻松，胜利都是用血换来的。
王爱梅见人越围越多，赶紧说道：“我说街坊邻居们，济民刚坐了几十个小时的火车，正累着呢，咱先散了吧！”
“听老王的，咱们先回去，以后啊，有时间听。”梁婶儿作为王爱梅忠诚的助手，立即出来附和。
“走吧走吧！”
等人散后，王爱梅关上屋门，问刘济民中午要不要出去吃，算是庆祝一下。
“妈，煮碗面条吃吧，我就惦记您这口。”
“那行，我去给你做面条，咱炒两个卤。”
即将迈入五月，燕京的天气稍微有点炎热，不过这大瓦房里面，还能感受到凉气和青砖的湿润味。
刘济民脱下外套，露出里面白色的背心，胳膊上的被弹片划破的伤痕清晰可见。王爱梅看到胳膊上的伤口，立即走了过来，心疼地摸了摸。
“其它地方还有没？”
“没了妈。”
王爱梅不放心，刘济民将背心脱了，说道：“您看，真的没了！”
“腿上呢？”
“真没，您放心吧！我都这么大人了，也不能把裤子脱了，让您检查啊！”
王爱梅乐呵呵地说道：“没事儿，我喊春燕奶奶过来看看。”

Courtyard No. 3 of Ju'er Hutong was extremely lively today. It was surrounded by people on three floors inside and three floors outside. It was like looking at a Western scene on the street. They all asked about the situation on the front line.
"Jimin, how many Vietnamese have you killed?"
"Oh, you're a great hero. He must have killed a lot of people. I read in the newspaper that he received first-class merit!"
"Isn't that right? The last person in our courtyard who went to war was the Guarjia clan, Ronglu!"
"Maybe, a general will appear!"
"On this big day, why are you mentioning that honor and salary? Isn't this a spoiler of fun!"
"Oh, that's true!"
When the descendants of Ronglu who gathered around heard this, they immediately walked out with dark faces.
Liu Jimin told everyone that the battlefield is not as easy as he said, and victory is bought with blood.
When Wang Aimei saw more and more people gathered around her, she quickly said: "My neighbors, Jimin has just been on the train for dozens of hours and is tired. Let's leave now!"
"Listen to Lao Wang, let's go back first. Later, when we have time, we can listen." Aunt Liang, as Wang Aimei's loyal assistant, immediately came out to agree.
"Let's go, let's go!"
After everyone dispersed, Wang Aimei closed the door and asked Liu Jimin if he wanted to go out to eat at noon to celebrate.
"Mom, make a bowl of noodles and eat them. I'm thinking about your bite."
"Okay, I'll make some noodles for you, and we'll stir-fry them."
May is about to enter, and the weather in Yanjing is a little hot, but inside this large tile-roofed house, you can still feel the cool air and the moist smell of blue bricks.
Liu Jimin took off his coat, revealing the white vest underneath, and the scars scratched by shrapnel on his arms were clearly visible. When Wang Aimei saw the wound on her arm, she immediately came over and touched it distressedly.
"Are there any other places?"
"No mother."
Wang Aimei was worried, so Liu Jimin took off his vest and said, "Look, it's really gone!"
"Where's the leg?"
"No, don't worry! I'm such an adult, I can't take off my pants for you to check!"
Wang Aimei said cheerfully: "It's okay, I'll ask Grandma Chunyan to come over and take a look."
